desc:
Merge fruits. Stack your collection. BECOME THE RICHEST. 🍎💰

How to Play:
🍎 MERGE fruits into BIGGER & RARER fruits
💰 Your fruits earn CASH every second - even whilst you're OFFLINE!
🚀 Grow your collection and become the fruit master
⚡ MERGE, UPGRADE & DISCOVER legendary fruits
🏆 Build the biggest fruit collection and dominate the leaderboard!

🍉 Can you collect EVERY fruit?

🎮 Playable on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet & Console!

🔥 NEW UPDATES EVERYDAY
🔔 Join the group for codes & updates!
